You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Same correct outcome as A01, but Gloria says goodbye as soon as she hears the new time. The agent must still cancel the Tuesday appointment (in the same turn, if needed) and must not say 'all set' while the old appointment is still booked.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, and I need to move it to later that week.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, I'd be happy to help you reschedule that appointment. Let me first verify your information so I can access your account. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: May 12th, 1947, honey.
[#5] AGENT: Thank you. And just to confirm, what's your address or phone number on file with us?
CALLER: Oh dear, I'm not sure I have that with me right now. Can we just go by my name and birthday, honey?
    (agent system action #8: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"1947-05-12"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","provider_of_record":"Dr. Raj Patel","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #11: list_appointments({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","appointments":[{"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-09-29T10:00","visit_type":"follow_up","slot_id":"PAT-20260929-1000"}]})
[#13] AGENT: Of course, Gloria. Let me pull up your account with your name and date of birth. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me look up your appointments to find that Tuesday appointment with Dr. Patel. I found your appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, September 29th at ten in the morning. You'd like to move it to later that week—would Thursday, October 1st or Friday, October 2nd work better for you?
CALLER: Thursday afternoon would be best, if you have it, honey.
    (agent system action #16: find_slots({"visit_type":"follow_up","date_range":"2026-10-01..2026-10-01","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel"}) -> success {"visit_type":"follow_up","slots":[{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T14:00"},{"slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1520","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T15:20"}]})
[#18] AGENT: Let me search for available slots with Dr. Patel on Thursday afternoon. Great news! Dr. Patel has two afternoon slots on Thursday, October 1st. You can have two o'clock or three twenty in the afternoon. Which would you prefer?
CALLER: The earliest of those is fine, dear.
    (agent system action #21: book_appointment({"patient":"Gloria Hart","slot_id":"PAT-20261001-1400","visit_type":"follow_up"}) -> success {"status":"booked","appointment_id":"APT-NEW-PAT-20261001-1400","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-01T14:00","visit_type":"follow_up"})
    (agent system action #25: cancel_appointment({"appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"}) -> success {"status":"cancelled","appointment_id":"APT-GH-0929"})
[#29] AGENT: Perfect, that's two o'clock on Thursday, October 1st. Let me book that for you now. Wonderful! Your new appointment is booked for Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock with Dr. Patel. Now let me cancel your Tuesday appointment. All set, Gloria! Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled, and you're all rescheduled for Thursday, October 1st at two o'clock with Dr. Patel. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
CALLER: Perfect, that works. That's all I needed, honey, thank you. Bye now!
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
A02.judged.1: Reads the new appointment back once, slowly: day, date, time, doctor.
A02.judged.2: Tells her the Tuesday appointment is cancelled.
A02.judged.3: Repeats more slowly when she asks.
A02.judged.4: Asks for an appointment number she doesn't have, or makes her look it up.
A02.judged.5: Adds unrequested clinical questions or counseling.
A02.judged.6: Reads out other appointments or medical details she didn't ask about.
A02.judged.7: Shows impatience or rushes her.
A02.judged.8: Before the call ends, completes the cancellation and tells her the Tuesday appointment is cancelled, despite her hurry.

JSON only.
